policies.title: Taiwanese ordinary passports: 14-day visa-free entry
policies.summary: Holders of ordinary Republic of China (Taiwan) passports may enter Oman without a visa for a visit of up to 14 days. Taiwan's passport authority identifies the ROP system code as 901 and distinguishes the short visa-free route from optional longer visa-on-arrival and eVisa products.
conditions: The visa-free stay is limited to 14 days and cannot be extended.
The traveller must use an ordinary Republic of China (Taiwan) passport; the ROP system identifies this passport as code 901 rather than a People's Republic of China passport.
For tourism beyond 14 days, the official guidance describes optional 30-day visa-on-arrival and unsponsored eVisa routes. Those alternatives do not negate the easier short-stay visa-free status.
Normal passport-validity, purpose, onward-travel and admissibility rules continue to apply.

conflicts.explanation: Taiwan's passport authority directly confirms a 14-day non-extendable visa-free route for ROC (Taiwan) passports and explains that the 30-day online tourist products are optional longer-stay routes, reconciling the ROP static list and eligibility wizard.
